run_split_domain_to_positions: run the script to download a domain-to-positions JSON from S3, shuffle keys, and split into 200 shards
run_shard_json_to_local: run the script to shard a large JSON dictionary into 200 smaller JSON files saved locally
run_upload_shards_to_s3: run the script to upload 200 sharded JSON files from local disk to an S3 bucket
run_download_json_from_s3: run the script to download a JSON file from an S3 path to a local scratch directory
run_shuffle_and_partition_keys: run the script to randomly shuffle dictionary keys and partition them into equal-sized shards
